correctness.rationale: This assesses the repaired claim. The frozen threshold paragraph overstates accessibility: for fixed R and h, its stated full persistence interval omits the cap δ≤R−h. For example R=6 and h=5 allow δ≤1, so the algebraic threshold √8 cannot be reached even though it is below the extinction amplitude. The repaired files retain the exact sign identity and give the actual feasible set and both threshold endpoints. To check the dynamics, write ρ=v/u. The two orbit equations imply ρ²−(a−b)ρ−1=0, with sole positive root r=Q+d. Substitution gives u²=(h−Q)/r and v²=r(h−Q), both positive precisely for ab>1, and verifies the original equations. In log abundance each season has derivative −tanh z; the positive two-step fixed point traps every starting point in the compact log interval of its initial distance from that point. On this interval the composition has derivative uniformly below one in modulus, so phase-wise convergence and the arithmetic time average follow. For ab≤1 the two-step ratio is strictly below one at every positive state; any positive limiting even state would, by continuity, give a limiting ratio strictly below one, impossible. This includes ab=1. At the positive orbit uv=h−Q, u²+v²=2Q(h−Q), giving the squared-arithmetic-mean identity after subtracting h−1. For unequal seasons and h>3 its zero occurs at δ_c=sqrt((h−2)²−1), strictly below the extinction amplitude. Since a,b=h±δ must be in (0,R], the tie is accessible iff R−h≥δ_c and both signs occur iff R−h>δ_c. At equality only the tied endpoint is added; for R=h there is no contrast. With h≤3 and persistence the sign is strictly negative for unequal seasons. The two R=10 examples straddle the threshold and their exact radical comparisons have the asserted signs.
residual_risks: The finite decimal trajectories are not proof and were not rerun. The fixed-R cap and the equality case are checked analytically. No formal certification is asserted.

value.rationale: The finite-amplitude result supplies a motivated boundary for when changing contrast while keeping arithmetic survival fixed can reverse a population-mean comparison. It separates local enhancement, feasibility of reaching the tie, suppression and extinction, with a globally reached census mean rather than a possibly unstable orbit. The survival cap adds a meaningful difference between an algebraic zero and an attainable contrast.
residual_risks: The result is for a deterministic two-season quadratic model and is not a general harvesting policy, profit, or conservation result.
